ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund has reported a substantial acquisition of 63,542 equity shares of CIE Automotive India Ltd. on September 17, 2026, increasing its total holding to 5.013% from 4.996%. This open market purchase triggered a mandatory disclosure under Regulation 29(1) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, due to exceeding the 5% ownership threshold. The fund explicitly states its intent is purely for investment purposes and not to seek controlling interest, indicating this is a routine regulatory filing with no apparent red flags.
